transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Sunday, August 30. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Nepal fights time, terrain to save 500 feared trapped in six hydro projects. Nepalese rescue operations are currently challenged by harsh weather and rugged terrain as teams strive to reach over 500 individuals trapped in six hydro-power sites impacted by flash floods. The Nepalese army and armed police are on the ground conducting rescue missions, yet inclement conditions and accessibility issues pose significant hurdles. They are leveraging technology, including drones and drilling rigs, to locate and assist the stranded individuals effectively. ' I take the blame myself': Suryakumar Yadav's big regret over failed ODI career. Suryakumar Yadav openly takes responsibility for his underwhelming ODI career, admitting he lacked the necessary dedication to the 50-over format. He struggles with the complexities of ODI cricket compared to T20s and expresses regret over not mastering the art of innings construction. Yadav reflects that his journey in ODI cricket feels incomplete and remains a lingering aspiration. Jamie Dimon says it is 'frustrating' to hear America is behind in defence tech. JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon voiced frustration regarding US defense technology perceptions. The bank launched a $1.5 trillion Security and Resiliency Initiative for national security industries. This program now includes Canada, Europe, and the United Kingdom. The initiative supports aerospace, defense, manufacturing, energy, and health tech sectors. 'I urge others to speak up': Ex-Pak cricketer's emotional appeal for Imran Khan. Moin Khan urges authorities to honour Imran Khan's right to medical care. He also asked fellow cricketers to voice their support for the former leader. International captains have also called for adequate healthcare and constitutional safeguards. Greg Chappell described Imran Khan's condition as worrying and difficult to ascertain. Nepal floods: 4 at hydropower tunnel among 108 Indians rescued; toll 682. Nepal's Bhote Koshi-Trishuli disaster death toll reached 675, with 2,426 people still missing. Rescuers searched mud-filled valleys and tunnels three days after the catastrophic flood occurred. Chinese authorities reported seven deaths and 554 missing at Gyirong port across the border. Indian nationals unaccounted for in Nepal were revised down to 287. Everest veterans, mountain guides enter choked hydropower tunnel to rescue 6. Highly trained mountain guides and Everest veterans joined flood rescue efforts in Nepal's Rasuwa district. Specialist teams used expedition skills to access disaster zones where roads had disappeared. Rescuers entered a mud-choked hydropower tunnel, pushing approximately 120 meters inside. They recovered a camera bag and determined excavation equipment was needed for deeper access. H-1B workers' 60-day grace period may end: What happens next. The US Department of Homeland Security is considering a proposal that may eliminate the 60-day grace period for foreign workers, particularly affecting H-1B visa holders and countless Indian professionals. This grace period currently allows individuals to seek new jobs or modify their status before needing to leave the US. Without it in place, workers may face immediate departure following job loss, with final details pending further evaluation. 'RSS vision is to see the world as one': Sangh chief Mohan Bhagwat at MSG event. NEW DELHI: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat, addressing around 5,000 members of Indian-American organisations at Madison Square Garden in New York, spoke about unity, pluralism, individual responsibility and the obligations of the Indian diaspora, while arguing that material success alone cannot define a fulfilling life. Toxic Day 4: Yash starrer dips 9.9 percent , crosses rupees 254.75 cr worldwide. Toxic recorded a decline in its India net collection on Saturday. The film earned an estimated rupees 24.50 crore net in India on Day 4. Its total India net collection has now reached rupees 190.45 crore. Worldwide gross collection for Toxic has reached rupees 254.75 crore. Sally Kellerman's daughter refuses to leave Scottish island in assistance dog row. Sally Kellerman's adopted daughter Claire Kellerman is embroiled in a legal dispute on Scotland's Great Bernera over her Australian cattle dog, which she says is an assistance animal. She has sued a community-run cafe under the Equality Act, while local groups face mounting legal bills. Kellerman calls the backlash a "witch hunt" and insists, "I'm not going anywhere." Trump-Putin-Zelenskyy summit floated in secret Moscow talks: Report. CIA Director John Ratcliffe proposed a trilateral meeting between US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky during his covert trip to Moscow this week, in a bid to revive efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war, Axios reported, citing two people briefed on the matter.

transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Bhopal Municipal Corporation Invites Bids For 'Son Chiraiya' Despite Council Deferring Proposal; Commissioner Orders Cancellation. BMC invited bids for a seven-year lease of the 'Son Chiraiya' Women's Hawkers' Corner even as the council sent the proposal back to the MiC for reconsideration on August 19. Bhopal Municipal Corporation Goes 100 percent Digital, Makes E-Filing Mandatory Across All Departments. Bhopal Municipal Corporation has completely stopped manual file movement and made e-filing mandatory across departments as part of a push for greater transparency and efficiency. Bhopal Dowry Cases: Only 14 Convictions In 3,187 Cases Since 2021, Over Half End In Compromise. Only 14 of 3,187 dowry harassment cases tried at Bhopal District Court between 2021 and June 2026 resulted in convictions, while 1,640 , about 51 percent , ended in compromise. MP School Education Report Card: No District Crosses 60 percent Mark, 45 Of 55 Stuck In 'Prachesta-2'. Not one of Madhya Pradesh's 55 districts crossed the 60 percent mark in the PGI-D 2025-26 school education assessment. MANIT Assistant Professor Arrested In Bhopal On Harassment, Threat Allegations. Mega Traffic Overhaul On Track; 25+ Flyovers, 1,500 City Buses Planned In Indore. Indore has drawn up a three-phase traffic overhaul targeting immediate bottlenecks and encroachments before moving to major infrastructure and public transport reforms. Woman dies 8 days after suicide attempt. Madhya Pradesh CM meets Amit Shah, discusses development in state. Mohan Yadav reviews Rewa floods, orders food and water for victims. DRI's rupees 4.72-Crore Gold Smuggling Probe Reaches Sarafa Bazar, Arrests Rise To Five In Indore. The DRI probe into a rupees 4.72-crore gold smuggling seizure in Indore has reached Sarafa Bazar, with bullion trader Deepak Khandelwal and his son Nakul arrested from Kota. Madhya Pradesh: Mohan Hints At Imminent Ministry Expansion, To Induct New Faces. Flood scare in MP: IAF helicopters, SDRF teams deployed as Mandakini river overflows. Accused In rupees 70-Crore MD Drug Case Arrested After 5 Years On The Run By Indore Crime Branch. Indore Crime Branch has arrested Akran Khan, wanted since 2021 in a major drug case involving the seizure of 70 kg of mephedrone worth around rupees 70 crore and rupees 13.03 lakh cash. Man rapes worker at construction site, held. Mandakini breaches 2003 record in monsoon deluge, Chitrakoot marooned. Women tie Rakhi to Madhya Pradesh CM during Balaghat visit.
